rule_summary: Research initiation is logically coupled with source management in the existing CLI structure, while monitoring and importing are handled by dedicated research commands [3, 4].
The implementation must utilize raw research primitives (start, poll, import_sources) from the SDK to allow for staged or selective research behavior [2, 4].
The research lifecycle must be exposed as a sequence of discrete stages—start, status/poll, and wait/import—rather than being collapsed into a single macro workflow [1-3].
